results.title: Call for papers Decolonizing Marketing Theory and Practice
results.content: Decolonizing Marketing Theory and Practice – going beyond the inclusivity and sustainability debates. This book would explore the idea of adopting a circular pedagogical approach to Marketing discipline to make it more sustainable and inclusive at the same time. The book would explore different avenues of pedagogical development in context of marketing theory and practice and identify areas where text, knowledge and contexts need to be decolonised and a shift of paradigm from culture of exclusion and western ideologies towards being open to inclusivity and a wide range of philosophical stance from the non-western world. This section would focus on discussions on decolonising the marketing discipline and how to ensure the inclusivity and diversity within the discipline is not just at a superficial level where they add new material from the non-Western world into existing theory and body of knowledge, but it should focus on new paradigms and knowledge emerging from the non-Western societies as well.
